description: This file defines the SimpleTaskSupport enum which provides static methods for managing asynchronous tasks, including starting, stopping, and starting detached looping tasks.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a task if it is not already running, executing the provided asynchronous operation.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the given task by canceling it and setting the task reference to nil.

methods.name: startDetachedLoop
methods.description: Starts a detached task that repeatedly executes an asynchronous operation at specified intervals until canceled.
